description: Solana Agent Identity Standard on devnet (Anchor 0.32.1): identity, verification, stake, reputation, validation and receipt anchors for AI agents. initialize_treasury, register_agent, get_verified, stake, submit_feedback, validate_work, submit_anchor, link_wallet, slash_agent, emergency_unstake and withdraw_fees were verified.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of SAID-Protocol/said. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/said. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program and set TREASURY_AUTHORITY to the Sol.College devnet deployer. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (identity, verification, stake, slash, anchors)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/said/
QA: devnet proof of the agent identity lifecycle
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Weight SAID feedback by reviewer stake or verification
